summary.text: This resolution expresses support for the designation of National Firearm Suicide Prevention Day.

title: Expressing support for the designation of September 9, 2025, as "National Firearm Suicide Prevention Day" to educate about the growing firearm suicide crisis in the United States and promote the importance of storing firearms safely and securely as an essential component of suicide prevention.
